findings.message: The second kāla is glossed 'Death' but has no sense field; mw-kala.md excerpt shows only 'time (in general)', 'N. of Śiva'. Sources support the idea (gitapress 'महाकालके भी काल', sanskritdocuments 'Devourer even of the great Time-Spirit'). w6.meaning says 'great Death' while components/literal say 'great Time'. Human should confirm.
findings.suggested_fix: Add a sense from MW kāla 2 ('time as destroying all things, death') if present, and make the word meaning use the same term as the components.
